Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly parse the address data from the webpage, leading to an incorrect distance calculation. Specifically, when extracting the address for "12 Steps Down" from the search results, the agent misread "831 Christian St" as "1 St" (likely due to OCR error or misinterpretation of the text "831 Christian St" where the "831 Christian" part was missed or garbled). This resulted in the distance calculation tool receiving an invalid address ("1 St, Philadelphia, PA 19147") instead of the correct one ("831 Christian St, Philadelphia, PA 19147"). Consequently, the calculated distance (0.66 miles straight line) was based on erroneous data, making the final conclusion about the closest bar unreliable. This error aligns with the pattern of "Inconsistent or Missing Outputs" and "Reliance on incorrect, incomplete, or misleading information retrieved from the web" seen in Example 2 and Example 10.
